metrics.heading: Spotting it again is not the same as bringing it back.

images.alt: Fold, a small apricot-yellow paper-page character, compares two retrieval tasks with the same teacup. On one side Fold points at a teacup among visible option cards, with the short label Recognition. On the other side Fold produces a teacup on a mostly blank card, with the short label Recall.
images.caption: Intended labels: Recognition — identify the teacup when it is shown again among options. Recall — retrieve the same teacup with fewer direct copies of the answer in view. Fold is a teaching character, not a person in a memory experiment. This scene is an illustration of the distinction, not a diagnostic memory test.

images.alt: 小折（Fold）是一个杏色小纸页角色，用同一只茶杯比较两种提取任务。一侧小折指向可见选项卡中的茶杯，短标签为 Recognition。另一侧小折在几乎空白的卡片上画出茶杯，短标签为 Recall。
images.caption: 图中原有短标签：Recognition（再认）——选项再次出现时认出茶杯。Recall（回忆）——眼前答案的直接副本更少时，提取同一只茶杯。小折是教学角色，不是记忆实验里的人。这幅场景用来说明区分，不是诊断性记忆测验。原图像素仍是英文标签 Recognition 与 Recall；本页只翻译了文字，没有改绘插图。

metrics.heading: Starting earlier still adds periods.At 0%, the amount stays 100.

images.alt: Reused original illustration: Fold, a yellow paper-page character with a teal folded corner, holds a taller stack of sheets labeled 早开始 (start early). A shorter stack to the right is labeled 晚开始 (start late). The Chinese labels remain in the image. A Grok mark is visible at lower right. Stack height is not an amount scale.
images.caption: This is the original illustration, reused with its Chinese labels still in the pixels. Fold holds a taller stack labeled 早开始 (“start early”) and stands beside a shorter stack labeled 晚开始 (“start late”). Those stacks picture more versus fewer elapsed compounding periods, not a money scale. On this 0% page the year-20 amounts are equal even though the stacks look different. A Grok mark is visible in the lower-right corner.
